title: Bronzehead arrow
content:
# Bronzehead arrow

Internal ID: ArrowBronze | Type: Arrow | Source: Forge | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Bronze x1, Feathers x2

# Introduction

Bronzehead arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from flinthead arrows.

## Availability

• Bronzehead arrows can be crafted at the forge once bronze is collected.

Categorias: Weapons, Arrows, Forge recipes
